info.title: EtijahFly API v1
info.description: EtijahFly B2B flight distribution API. Partner endpoints (/partner/*) are tenant-scoped; admin endpoints (/admin/*) require platform permissions. Money-moving POSTs require an Idempotency-Key header. Errors: {message, code, details|errors}.

post.description:
The token is meant to be stored server-side by the portal (httpOnly cookie), not in
browser storage. Wrong portal, unknown e-mail and wrong password share one error.

Request a password reset link. Always returns the same response
